sloka: पतिते त्वनृते तस्मिन्नधर्मे च महीतले ।शुभान्येवाचरँल्लोकः सत्यधर्मपरायणः ।। ७.७४.१९ ॥
transliteration: patite tvanṛte tasminnadharme ca mahītale ।śubhānyevācaram̐llokaḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 7.74.19 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, even when that untruth and unrighteousness had descended upon the earth, people devoted to truth and righteousness still performed only auspicious deeds.
